newsitem.title: GUINEA: French cooperation minister visits Guinea.
newsitem.headline: French cooperation minister visits Guinea.

text.p: French Cooperation Minister Jacques Godfrain held talks with Guinea's President, Lansana Conte, on Thursday during a brief visit to the West African nation, officials said.

Godfrain, who arrived late on Wednesday, told Reuters that former colonial power France welcomed progress made by Prime Minister Sidia Toure and his government since his appointment in July. Godfrain leaves on Thursday.
